ख: ख The second consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding; it is written in the Roman character Kh.

ख n. (-खं) 1 Heaven. 2 Sky or ether. 3 An organ of sense. 4 Knowledge. 5 Happiness, pleasure. 6 Vacuity. 7 A dot, a cypher. 8 A city, a field. 9 Action. 10 Auspiciousness. 11 Talc. 12 The tenth constellation from any given one, or the sun's entrance into it. 13 Brahma the supreme spirit. m. (-खः) A name of the sun. E. खन to dig, to penetrate, affix ड.
खकुन्तल: खकुन्तल m. (-लः) A name of ŚIVA. E. ख ether, कुन्तल hair.
खक्ख: खक्ख r. 1st cl. (खक्खति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride; also कख.
खक्खट: खक्खट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Hard, solid: see कक्खट.
खखोल्क: खखोल्क m. (-ल्कः) The sun. E. ख the sky, and खोल्क a meteor, &c.
खग: खग m. (-गः) 1 A bird. 2 An arrow. 3 The sun. 4 A planet. 5 A deity. 6 Air, wind. 7 A grasshopper. E. ख the sky, &c. and ग who goes.
खगपति: खगपति m. (-तिः) A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. खग a bird, and पति lord or chief.
खगम: खगम m. (-मः) A bird. E. ख and गम what goes.
खगवक्त्र: खगवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A tree, commonly Lakucha, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E. खग a bird, and वक्त्र face, bird-faced.
खगवती: खगवती f. (-ती) The earth. E. खग a bird, &c. मतुप् poss. aff.
खगशत्रु: खगशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A plant, commonly Chakuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) E. खग a bird, and शत्रु an enemy.
खगस्थान: खगस्थान n. (-नं) 1 The hollow of a tree. 2 A bird's nest. E. खग a bird, स्थान place.
खगान्तक: खगान्तक m. (-कः) A hawk, a falcon. E. खग, and अन्तक destroyer.
खगासन: खगासन m. (-नः) 1 The eastern mountain over which the sun rises. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. E. खग a bird or the sun, and आसन seat or place of abiding.
खगेन्द्र: खगेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of GARUḌA. E. खग, and इन्द्र chief.
खगेन्द्रध्वज: खगेन्द्रध्वज m. (-जः) VIṢṆU. E. खगेन्द्र, and ध्वज emblem.
खगेश्वर: खगेश्वर m. (-रः) GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU; also खगेश. E. खग, and ईश्वर king of birds.
खगोड: खगोड m. (-डः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
खगोल: खगोल m. (-लः) 1 The vault or circle of the heavens, the planisphere. 2 The same represented artificially, the armillary sphere. E. ख, and गोल sphere.
खगोलविद्या: खगोलविद्या f. (-द्या) Astronomy. E. खगोल, and विद्या knowledge.
खङ्कर: खङ्कर m. (-रः) A curl, a lock of hair.
खच: खच r. 1st cl. (खचति) also r. 9th cl. (खन्नाति) 1 To be past birth. 2 To cause prosperity. 3 To purify. r. 10th cl. (खचयति) To fasten, to bind, to set.
खचमस: खचमस m. (-सः) The moon. E. ख the sky, चम to eat, and अस aff.
खचर: खचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Moving in the sky, flying in the air. m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 An aerial spirit. 3 Air, wind. 4 A demon. 5 The sun. 6 A bird. E. ख the sky, and चर who goes, from चर to go, affix ट; see also खेचर.
खचित: खचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mixed, blended, inlaid. 2 Joined, combined. E. खच to fasten, &c. affix क्त.
खज: खज r. 1st cl. (खजति) To churn or agitate. (इ,) खजि (खञ्जति) To limp, to halt, to walk lame or ill.
खज m. (-जः) A ladle, a spoon. f. (-जा) 1 Churning, stirring. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 The palm with the fingers extended. E. खज to agitate, &c. affix अच्.
खजक: खजक m. (-कः) The churning stick. f. (-जिका) A ladle or spoon. E. खज to churn or agitate, affix ण्वुल्.
खजप: खजप m. (-पः) Ghee or clarified butter. E. खज to stir or agitate, Uṇādi affix अप.
खजल: खजल n. (-लं) 1 Frost, hoar-frost. 2 Dew, rain. E. ख the sky, and जल water.
खजाक: खजाक mf. (-कः-का) A spoon, a ladle. m. (-कः) A bird. E. खज to agitate, and आक Uṇādi aff.
खजित्: खजित् m. (जित्) A Buddha, one of seven teachers or saints of the Buddha sect. E. ख heaven, and जित् who subdues.
खज्योतिस्: खज्योतिस् m. (-तिः) A fire-fly. E. ख, and ज्योतिस् light.
खञ्ज: खञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Lame, crippled, limping. f. (-ञ्जा) A species of metre, a stanza of two lines, one of thirty-two, the other of thirty feet. E. खजि to limp or go lame, affix अच्.
खञ्जक: खञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Lame, limping. E. खजि to limp, affix वुन्.
खञ्जखेट: खञ्जखेट m. (-टः) A wag-tail. E. खञ्ज lame, and खेट who moves.
खञ्जखेल: खञ्जखेल m. (-लः) A wag-tail. E. खञ्ज lame, and खेल who moves, from खेल to move, affix अच्.
खञ्जन: खञ्जन m. (-नः) A small bird, the wag-tail, (Motacilla alba.) f. (-ना) 1 A small kind of wag-tail. 2 Mustard. n. (-र्नं) Going, moving. E. खजि to go lamely, affix ल्यु.
खञ्जनरत: खञ्जनरत n. (-तं) The cohabitation of saints. E. खञ्जन a wag-tail, and रत cohabitation.
खञ्जनाकृति: खञ्जनाकृति f. (-तिः) A sort of wag-tail.
खञ्जनिका: खञ्जनिका f. (-का) A kind of wag-tail.
खञ्जरीट: खञ्जरीट m. (-टः) A wag-tail. E. खञ्ज lame, ऋ to go, कीटन् affix, deriv. irr.
खट: खट r. 1st cl. (खटति) To desire, to wish, to seek or inquire.

खट m. (-टः) 1 Grass. 2 Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humor. 3 A blind well. 4 An axe, a hatchet. 5 A closed or doubled fist, as for striking. 6 A plough. 7 A fragrant kind of grass: see कत्तृण. E. खट to seek, to wish, affix अच्.
खटक: खटक m. (-कः) 1 A go-between, a man whose business it is to negociate marriages: see घटक. 2 The doubled fist of wrestlers or boxers. E. खट to seek, to wish, affix वुन्.
खटकामुख: खटकामुख m. (-खः) A man in the attitude of shooting.
खटखादक: खटखादक m. (-कः) 1 An eater. 2 A glass vessel. 3 A jackal. 4 An animal. 5 A crow.
खटिक: खटिक m. (-कः) The fist, the hand closed. f. (-का) 1 Chalk. 2 The external opening of the ear. 3 A fragrant grass: (Andropogon muricatus.) E. खट to seek or wish, वुन् affix, and इट् inserted.
खटिनी: खटिनी f. (-नी) Chalk. E. खट to seek, इनि affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also कठिनी.
खटी: खटी f. (-टी) Chalk. E. खट to seek, अच् and ङीष् affs.
खट्ट: खट्ट r. 10th cl. (खट्टयति) To cover, to screen.
खट्टन: खट्टन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dwarfish, short of stature. E. खट्ट to cover or hide, affix ल्यु.
खट्टा: खट्टा f. (-ट्टा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) E. खट्ट to screen, अङ् and टाप् affs.
खट्टाश: खट्टाश mf. (-शः-शी) The civet or zebet cat, (Viverra zibetha.) E. खट्टा the grass, and अश who eats; also खट्टास.
खट्टास: खट्टास m. (-सः) The civet: see the preceding.
खट्टि: खट्टि m. (-ट्टिः) A bier, the bed on which the corpse is carried to the pile; also खट्टी. E. खट्ट to screen, affix कि.
खट्टिक: खट्टिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A hunter, a fowler, one who lives by killing and selling game. f. (-का) 1 A small bedstead, a cot. 2 A bier or bed on which the corpse is carried. E. खट्ट to screen, इकन् aff.
खट्वा: खट्वा f. (-ट्वा) 1 A bedstead, a cot, a couch. 2 A hammock, a swing. E. खट्ट to hide, Uṇādi affix कन्.
खट्वाङ्ग: खट्वाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गं) A king of the solar line. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Part of a bed. 2 A club or staff with a skull at the top of it, considered as a weapon of ŚIVA, and carried by penitents and Yogis. 3 Wood from a funeral pile. E. खट्वा a cot, and अङ्क body or form.
खट्वाङ्गभृत्: खट्वाङ्गभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of ŚIVA. खट्वाङ्ग one of his weapons, भृत् who maintains.
खट्वाङ्गिन्: खट्वाङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A name of ŚIVA. E. खट्वाङ्ग, and इनि aff.
खट्वारूढ: खट्वारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Low, vile, abandoned, iniquitous. 2 Erring, going wrong. 3 Stupid, silly. 4 Laid or lying on a bed. E. खट्वा a bed, and आरूढ mounted.
खट्विका: खट्विका f. (-का) A small bedstead. E. खट्वा a bedstead, and कन् affix, fem. form.
खड: खड r. 10th cl. (खाडयति) also (इ,) खडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (खण्डति खण्डयति) and (इ ङ) खडिङ् r. 1st cl. (खण्डते) To divide, to tear, to break off a part or piece.
खड m. (-डः) 1 Breaking, dividing. 2 Buttermilk boiled with acid vegetables and spices. 3 A small grass. f. (-डी) Chalk. E. खड to break, &c. affix अच्.
खडक्किका: खडक्किका f. (-का) A private or back door, a small or venetian door or window.
खडिका: खडिका f. (-का) Chalk. E. खड to break, affix वुन् fem. form.
खडु: खडु m. (-डुः) A bier. E. खड to break, affix उ.
खड्ग: खड्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A rhinoceros. 2 A rhinoceros horn. 3 A sword, a scimitar. 4 A large sacrificial knife. 5 One of the Buddhas or Bauddha saints. n. (-ङ्गं) Iron. E. खड to tear or rend, Uṇādi affix गन.
खड्गकोष: खड्गकोष m. (-षः) 1 A creeping plant, (Scirpus maximus.) 2 A scabbard, a sheathe. E. खङ्ग a sword, and कोष a sheathe.
खड्गचर्मधर: खड्गचर्म्मधर m. (-रः) A soldier armed with a sword and shield. E. खड्ग, and चर्म्म a shield, धर who bears.
खड्गचर्म्मधर: खड्गचर्म्मधर m. (-रः) A soldier armed with a sword and shield. E. खड्ग, and चर्म्म a shield, धर who bears.
खड्गट: खड्गट m. (-टः) A large kind of Kās, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. खड्ग the rhinoceros, and अट who goes; these animals being usually found amongst high grass or reeds.
खड्गधर: खड्गधर m. (-रः) A swordsman. E. खड्ग, and धर who holds.
खड्गधेनु: खड्गधेनु f. (-नुः) 1 A small knife. 2 A female rhinoceros. E. खड्ग a sword, &c. धेनु a cow, used here as a diminutive.
खड्गपत्र: खड्गपत्र m. (-त्रः) The name of a creeper, (Scirpus maximus.) n. (-त्रं) The blade of a sword. E. खड्ग a sword, and पत्र a leaf.
खड्गपाणि: खड्गपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Holding a sword. E. खड्ग, and पाणि the hand.
खड्गपात्र: खड्गपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel of buffalo's horn. E. खड्ग, and पात्र a vessel.
खड्गपिधान: खड्गपिधान n. (-नं) A scabbard, a sheathe. E. खड्ग a sword, and पिधान a sheathe; also with कन् added, खड्गपिधानक.
खड्गपुत्त्रिका: खड्गपुत्त्रिका f. (-का) A knife, a small sword. E. खड्ग, and पुत्त्रिका infant.
खड्गप्रहार: खड्गप्रहार m. (-रः) A sword cut. E. खड्ग, and प्रहार a stroke.
खड्गमांस: खड्गमांस m. (-सः) Buffalo-beef. E. खड्ग, and मांस flesh.
खड्गलेखा: खड्गलेखा f. (-खा) A row of sabres. E. खड्ग, and लेखा a line.
खड्गराट: खड्गराट m. (-टः) 1 A shield. 2 One who observes a peculiar religious obligation, rubbing the feet backwards and forwards on the edge of a sword made red hot, this is a penance peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. खड्ग a sword, रट to speak, deriv. irr.
खड्गाघात: खड्गाघात m. (-तः) A sword cut. E. खड्ग, and आघात a blow.
खड्गाधार: खड्गाधार m. (-रः) A sheathe, a scabbard. E. खड्ग, and आधार what receives.
खड्गाभिहत: खड्गाभिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut or struck with a sword. E. खड्ग, and अभिहत struck.
खड्गामिष: खड्गामिष n. (-षं) Buffalo's flesh. E. खड्ग, and आमिष flesh.
खड्गिक: खड्गिक m. (-कः) 1 The cream or froth of buffalo's milk. 2 A vender of flesh meat. E. खड्ग a sword, &c. affix ठक्.
खड्गिन्: खड्गिन् mfn. (-ड्गी-ड्गिनी-ड्गि) Armed with a sword. m. (-ड्गी) 1 A rhinoceros. 2 A Jina or Jaina saint. E. खड्ग a horn, &c. affix इनि.
खड्गिमार: खड्गिमार m. (-रः) A kind of creeper: see खड्गकोष. E. खड्गि a rhinoceros, and मार what destroys.
खड्गीक: खड्गीक m. (-कः) A sickle, a scythe. E. खड्ग a scymitar, and ईकन् aff.
खण्ड: खण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 A piece, a part, a fragment, a portion. 2 A chapter, a section. 3 A term in an equation. m. (-ण्डः) A flaw in a jewel. 2 Treacle or molasses partially dried or candied. n. (-ण्डं) 1 A sort of sugar cane. 2 Black salt. E. खडि to break, and घञ् affix, or खन to tear, affix ड, and न changed to ण.
खण्डक: खण्डक m. (-कः) 1 Pared or clipped finger nails. 2 A part, a piece. E. खण्ड to tear, वुन् aff.
खण्डकथा: खण्डकथा f. (-था) A tale or story divided into sections. E. खण्ड a section, and कथा a story.
खण्डकालु: खण्डकालु n. (-लु) An esculent root, sweet potatoe: also खण्डकालुक. n. (-कं) E. खण्डक a portion, and आलु any esculent root.
खण्डकाव्य: खण्डकाव्य n. (-व्यं) A poem interspersed with prose. E. खण्ड, and काव्य a poem.
खण्डज: खण्डज m. (-जः) Treacle, molasses. E. खण्ड, and ज what is produced.
खण्डधारा: खण्डधारा f. (-रा) Shears, scissors. E. खण्ड a part, and धृ to have or hold, in the causal form.
खण्डन: खण्डन n. (-नं) 1 Breaking, dividing, cutting, reducing to pieces. 2 Destroying, annihilating. 3 Refuting, (in argument.) 4 Rebellion, opposition. E. खण्ड to break, ल्युट् aff.
खण्डनरत: खण्डनरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destructive, skilful in cutting or destroying. E. खण्डन, and रत engaged in.
खण्डनीय: खण्डनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Brittle, fragile. 2 Refutable. 4 Destructible, &c. E. खडि, and अनीयर् affix; also खण्ड्य, and खण्डितव्य.
खण्डपत्र: खण्डपत्र m. (-त्रं) A bundle of various leaves. E. खण्ड, and पत्र a leaf.
खण्डपरशु: खण्डपरशु m. (-शुः) A name of ŚIVA. E. खण्ड a part, and परशु a hatchet; cutting his foes to pieces.
खण्डपर्शु: खण्डपर्शु m. (-र्शुः) 1 A name of PARAŚURĀMA. 2 A name of ŚIVA. 3 Rāhu, the personified ascending node. 5 A spreader of unguents, fragrant powders, &c. 5 A drug, commonly Candāmalaki. 6 An elephant with a broken tusk. E. खण्ड a part, and पर्शु an axe; whose axe or arms cut every thing to pieces.
खण्डपाल: खण्डपाल m. (-लः) A confectioner, a seller of sweetmeats. E. खण्ड molasses, and पाल who cherishes.
खण्डप्रलय: खण्डप्रलय m. (-यः) Partial destruction of the universe, the destruction of the division of the terrestrial world. E. खण्ड, and प्रलय destruction.
खण्डमण्डल: खण्डमण्डल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Gibbous, not full or round. n. (-लं) A segment of a circle, part of a circle or an incomplete sphere. E. खण्ड, and मण्डल sphere.
खण्डमोदक: खण्डमोदक m. (-कः) Granulated sugar. E. खण्ड, and मोदक a sweetmeat.
खण्डलवण: खण्डलवण n. (-णं) Black salt. E. खण्ड, and लवण salt.
खण्डशस्: खण्डशस् ind. Piece-meal, in or by pieces. E. खण्ड, and शसि aff.
खण्डसर: खण्डसर m. (-रः) Granulated sugar. E. खण्ड, and सर what goes.
खण्डाभ्र: खण्डाभ्र n. (-भ्रं) 1 Scattered clouds. 2 A bite, the impression of the teeth. E. खण्ड a part, and अभ्र a cloud, &c.
खण्डाली: खण्डाली f. (-ली) 1 A measure for oil. 2 A pond. 3 A woman whose husband has been guilty of infidelity.
खण्डिक: खण्डिक m. (-कः) 1 Pease. 2 The armpit. E. खडि to break, इकन् aff.
खण्डित: खण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut, torn, broken in pieces. 2 Destroyed. 3 Broken as allegiance, disobeyed against, rebelled. 4 Refuted, controverted. 5 Scattered, dispersed. 6 Disappointed. 7 Betrayed, abandoned, (as a lover.) f. (-ता) A woman whose husband or lover has been guilty of infidelity. E. खडि to cut, affix क्त.
खण्डितव्य: खण्डितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be broken, what may or ought to be broken, confuted, destroyed, &c. E. खडि, and तव्य aff.
खण्डितविग्रह: खण्डितविग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Maimed, mutilated. E. खण्डित, and विग्रह body.
खण्डिताशंस: खण्डिताशंस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Disappointed, foiled, frustrated. E. खण्डित, and आशंसा expectation.
खण्डिन्: खण्डिन् mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि) 1 In pieces or parts, divided, comminuted, &c. 2 Consisting of pieces or parts. m. (-ण्ड,) A wild  kind of kidney bean: see वनमद्ग. f. (-नी) The earth. E. खण्ड a portion, and इनि aff.
खण्डीर: खण्डीर m. (-रः) A kind of kidney bean: see पीतमुद्ग. E. खण्ड a part, ईरन् aff.
खण्ड्य: खण्ड्य mfn. (ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं) What may or ought to be broken, &c. see खण्डितव्य. E. खडि, and यत् aff.
खतमाल: खतमाल m. (-लः) 1 Smoke. 2 A cloud. E. ख the sky, तमाल a tree with dark blossoms; the etherial Tamāla.
खद: खद r. 1st cl. (खदति) 1 To be steady or firm. 2 To hurt or kill. 3 To eat. r. 10th cl. (खदयति) To cover.
खदिका: खदिका m. (-का) Fried or parched grain.
खदिर: खदिर m. (-रः) 1 A tree, the resin of which is used in medicine, Khayar, Terra japonica or catechu, (Mimosa catechu.) 2 A name of INDRA. 3 The moon. f. (-री) A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. खद to hurt, Uṇādi affix इरच्.
खदिरपत्री: खदिरपत्री f. (-त्री) The sensitive plant. E. खदिर, and पत्र a leaf, affix ङीप्; also with कन् added खदिरपत्रिका.
खदूरक: खदूरक n. (-कं) A dwarf. E. ख, and दूर afar, कन् aff.
खदूरवासिनी: खदूरवासिनी f. (-नी) One of the female deities or Śaktis of the Buddhas. E. ख heaven, दूर ill, and वासिनी who abides.
खद्योत: खद्योत m. (-तः) 1 A fire-fly. 2 The sun. E. ख the sky, and द्योत what is luminous.
खद्योतन: खद्योतन m. (-नः) The sun. E. ख heaven, and द्युत to shine, affix ल्युट.
खधूप: खधूप m. (-पः) A rocket, a fire work. E. ख, and धूप incense.
खन: खन (उ,) खनु r. 1st cl. (खनति-ते) 1 To dig or delve. 2 To hurt.
खनक: खनक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Tearing, dividing. 2 Digging, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A rat. 2 A housebreaker. 3 A miner. E. खन to dig, affix ण्वुल्.
खनत्: खनत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) Digging. E. खन, and शतृ aff.
खनि: खनि f. (-निः or -नी) A mine, especially of precious stones; when used in composition with आकर, more commonly a mine of the precious metals. E. खन to dig, इन् affix, and ङीष् optionally added.
खनितृ: खनितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what digs or delves, a digger, a ditcher, &c. E. खन to dig, तृच् aff.
खनित्र: खनित्र n. (-त्रं) A spade or hoe. E. खन to dig, इत्रच् aff.
खपुर: खपुर m. (-रः) 1 The betel tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) 3 Garlic. 4 Flatulence. n. (-रं) 1 A water jar. 2 A city in the sky, the city of HARIŚCANDRA. E. ख the heavens, &c. पृ to nourish, affix क.
खभ्रान्ति: खभ्रान्ति m. (न्तिः) A kite. E. ख the sky, भ्रम to roam, affix क्तिन्.
खमणि: खमणि m. (-णिः) The sun. E. ख the sky, and मणि a jewel.
खमीलन: खमीलन n. (-नं) Lassitude, weariness, sleepiness. E. ख the sky, and मीलन twinkling.
खमूर्ति: खमूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) A celestial appearance or person. E. ख, and मूर्त्ति form.
खमूर्त्ति: खमूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) A celestial appearance or person. E. ख, and मूर्त्ति form.
खमूर्तिमत्: खमूर्त्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having a divine or celestial person or form. E. खमूर्त्ति, and मतुप् aff.
खमूर्त्तिमत्: खमूर्त्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having a divine or celestial person or form. E. खमूर्त्ति, and मतुप् aff.
खमूलि: खमूलि f. (-लिः or -ली or -लिका) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes). E. ख ether, मूल a root, affixes इन् or ङीष्; also खमूलिका.
खम्ब: खम्ब r. 1st cl. (खम्बति) To go or move.
खर: खर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Hot. 2 Sharp, pungent. 3 Sharp, sharp-edged, cutting. 4 Cruel, harsh. mn. (-रः-रं) Heat. m. (-रः) 1 An ass. 2 A Rākṣasa, the brother of RĀVAṆA. 3 A Daitya or demon in general. 4 A sort of prickly nightshade. 5 A crow. 6 A heron. 7 An osprey. f. (-रा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) E. ख an organ of sense, and रा to get or give, affix क.
खरकुटि: खरकुटि f. (-टिः or टी) A barber's shop. E. खर heat, and कुटि a dwelling; also written खरकुट्टि.
खरकोण: खरकोण m. (-णः) The francoline partridge. E. खर heat, कुण to sound, affix अच्.
खरगृह: खरगृह n. (-हं) An ass's stable. E. खर an ass, and गृह a house.
खरगेह: खरगेह n. (-हं) A stable for asses. E. खर, and गेह a house.
खरग्रह: खरग्रह n. (-हं) A stable for asses. E. खर, and ग्रह a house.
खरघातन: खरघातन m. (-नः) A plant, commonly Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.) E. खर an ass, and घातन mischievous.
खरच्छद: खरच्छद m. (-दः) 1 A kind of reed or grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.) 2 Also another kind, commonly Okera. E. खर warm, sharp, छद a leaf.
खरणस्: खरणस् mfn. (-णाः-णाः-णः) Sharp-nosed. E. खर sharp, नस् from नासिका a nose; also with a final vowel खरणस (-सः-सा-सं.)
खरदण्ड: खरदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A lotus, (Nymphaea lotus.) E. खर sharp, and दण्ड stick or stem.
खरदला: खरदला f. (-ला) Opposite leaved fig tree. E. खर hot, दल leaf.
खरदूषण: खरदूषण m. (-णः) Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) E. खर an ass, and दूषण hurting; by its narcotic properties.
खरध्वंसिन्: खरध्वंसिन् m. (-सी) A name of RĀMA. E. खर an imp or goblin so called, and ध्वंसिन् the destroyer.
खरनाद: खरनाद m. (-दः) The braying of an ass. E. खर, and नाद noise.
खरनादिन्: खरनादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Braying as an ass. f. (-नी) A kind of perfume: see रेणुका. E. खरनाद and इनि aff.
खरपत्र: खरपत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 A red sort of Tulasi or basil. 2 The teak tree, (Tectona grandis.) E. खर hot, and पत्र a leaf.
खरपत्रक: खरपत्रक m. (-कः) A plant: see तिलक. E. कन् added to खरपत्र hot leaved.
खरपात्र: खरपात्र n. (-त्रं) An iron pot or vessel. E. खर an ass, and पात्र a vessel; fit for such an animal.
खरपादाद्य: खरपादाद्य m. (-द्यः) The elephant or wood apple, (Feronia elephantium:) see कपित्थ.
खरपाल: खरपाल m. (-लः) A wooden vessel. E. खर, and पाल what cherishes.
खरपुष्प: खरपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, commonly Marüa: see मरुवक. f. (-ष्पा or ष्पिका) A kind of Tulasi, (Ocymum gratissimum;) also वर्वर. E. खर sharp, hot, पुष्प a flower.
खरप्रिय: खरप्रिय m. (-यः) A pigeon. E. खर hot, and प्रिय fond, dear.
खरमञ्जरी: खरमञ्जरी f. (-री) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera:) see अपामार्ग. E. खर sharp, pungent, and मञ्जरी a pedicle.
खरयान: खरयान n. (-नं) A vehicle drawn by asses. E. खर, and यान a carriage.
खरलोमन्: खरलोमन् m. (-मा) One of the chiefs of the Nāga or serpent race inhabiting hell. E. खर an ass, and लोमन् hair of the body; having the skin of an ass.
खरवल्लिका: खरवल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Gorakṣa Cākuliya, (Hedysarum lagopodiodes.) E. खर hot, sharp, वल्लिका a pedicle.
खरशब्द: खरशब्द m. (-ब्दः) 1 An osprey. 2 The braying of an ass. E. खर, and शब्द sound.
खरशाल: खरशाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Born or produced in an ass's stall. f. (-ला) An ass's stable or stall. E. खर, and शाला a hall; in the first sense the final is dropped.
खरसोल्ल: खरसोल्ल m. (-ल्लः) An iron vessel; also read खरसोनि.
खरांशु: खरांशु m. (-शुः) The sun. E. खर hot, and अंशु a ray.
खरागरी: खरागरी f. (-री) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus;) also देवताड. E. खर venom, गृ to take, with आङ् prefixed, अच् and ङीष् affixes; antivenomous, an antidote.
खरालक: खरालक m. (-कः) An iron arrow; also खरालिक. m. (-कः).
खराश्वा: खराश्वा f. (-श्वा) A plant, (Celosia cristata.) E. खर an ass, अश to be eaten, and व and टाप् affs.
खरिका: खरिका f. (-का) Musk in powder. E. खर, कन् added, fem. form.
खरिन्धय: खरिन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Drinking ass's milk. E. खरी, and धे to drink, खश् aff.
खरु: खरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः or -रूः-रु) 1 White. 2 Desirous of improper or prohibited things. 3 A fool, foolish, idiotic. 4 Harsh, cruel. m. (-रुः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A horse. 3 A tooth. 4 Pride. 5 Love or the deity KĀMA. 6 White, the colour. E. खन to dig, &c. Uṇādi affix कु, and र substituted for the final.
खर्ब: खर्ब r. 10th cl. (खर्ब्वति) To go or move.
खर्ब r. 1st cl. (खर्बंति) To go, to move to or towards.

खर्ब्ब mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बा-र्ब्बं) A dwarf, short, low, of little size or stature. m. (-र्ब्बः) One of KUVERA'S nine Nidhis or treasures. n. (-र्ब्बं) A large number, ten million-millions. E. खर्ब्ब or खर्व्व to be small, to go, to move, affix अच्; also खर्व्व.
खर्ज: खर्ज r. 1st cl. (खर्जति) 1 To worship, to treat with respect or courtesy. 2 To pain or make uneasy. 3 To cleanse or make clean.
खर्जिका: खर्जिका f. (-का) A relish, a provocative to drinking. E. खर्ज to pain, and वुन् affix, fem. form.
खर्जू: खर्ज्जू f. (-र्ज्जूः) 1 Cutaneous eruption, itch, scab, &c. 2 A worm, an insect. E. खर्जि to give pain, Uṇādi affix ऊ.
खर्ज्जू: खर्ज्जू f. (-र्ज्जूः) 1 Cutaneous eruption, itch, scab, &c. 2 A worm, an insect. E. खर्जि to give pain, Uṇādi affix ऊ.
खर्जूर: खर्ज्जूर n. (-रं) 1 Silver. 2 The fruit of the date. 3 Yellow orpiment. m. (-रः) 1 The date tree, (Phoenix sylvestris.) 2 A scorpion. f. (-री) The wild date tree. E. खर्ज to give pain, &c. Uṇādi affix ऊर.
खर्ज्जूर: खर्ज्जूर n. (-रं) 1 Silver. 2 The fruit of the date. 3 Yellow orpiment. m. (-रः) 1 The date tree, (Phoenix sylvestris.) 2 A scorpion. f. (-री) The wild date tree. E. खर्ज to give pain, &c. Uṇādi affix ऊर.
खर्जूररस: खर्ज्जूररस m. (-सः) The juice or extract of the wild date, Tāri, used to leaven bread, and as an intoxicating liquor, when in a state of spontaneous fermentation. E. खर्ज्जूर, and रस juice.
खर्ज्जूररस: खर्ज्जूररस m. (-सः) The juice or extract of the wild date, Tāri, used to leaven bread, and as an intoxicating liquor, when in a state of spontaneous fermentation. E. खर्ज्जूर, and रस juice.
खर्द: खर्द r. 1st cl. (खर्दति) To bite, to sting, to sting venomously.
खर्पर: खर्प्पर mf. (-रः-री) A kind of collyrium or application to the eyes: see कर्पर. m. (-रः) 1 A thief. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 A beggar's bowl or dish. 4 The half of a skull. 5 An umbrella or parasol.
खर्प्पर: खर्प्पर mf. (-रः-री) A kind of collyrium or application to the eyes: see कर्पर. m. (-रः) 1 A thief. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 A beggar's bowl or dish. 4 The half of a skull. 5 An umbrella or parasol.
खर्द्ध: खर्द्ध r. 1st cl. (खर्घति) To go, to move.
खर्पराल: खर्पराल m. (-लः) A plant: see कन्दराल.
खर्प्परीतूत्थ: खर्प्परीतूत्थ n. (-त्थं) A sort of collyrium.
खर्ब्ब: खर्ब्ब mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बा-र्ब्बं) A dwarf, short, low, of little size or stature. m. (-र्ब्बः) One of KUVERA'S nine Nidhis or treasures. n. (-र्ब्बं) A large number, ten million-millions. E. खर्ब्ब or खर्व्व to be small, to go, to move, affix अच्; also खर्व्व.
खर्बशाख: खर्ब्बशाख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Small, short, dwarfish. E. खर्ब्ब short, and शाखा a branch.
खर्ब्बशाख: खर्ब्बशाख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Small, short, dwarfish. E. खर्ब्ब short, and शाखा a branch.
खर्व: खर्व्व r. 1st cl. (खर्व्वति) To be proud, or haughty.
खर्व्व mfn. (र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) A dwarf, &c.: see खर्ब्ब.
खर्व्व: खर्व्व r. 1st cl. (खर्व्वति) To be proud, or haughty.
खर्व्व mfn. (र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) A dwarf, &c.: see खर्ब्ब.
खर्वट: खर्व्वट mn. (-टः-टं) 1 The capital of a district of four hundred villages, a market or country town. 2 A village at the foot of a mountain. E. खर्व्व being proud, and अट what goes or is.
खर्व्वट: खर्व्वट mn. (-टः-टं) 1 The capital of a district of four hundred villages, a market or country town. 2 A village at the foot of a mountain. E. खर्व्व being proud, and अट what goes or is.
खल: खल r. 1st cl. (खर्लति) 1 To gather. 2 To move.

खल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Low, vile, base. 2 Low, inferior. 3 Cruel, mischievous, mischief-making. 4 Bad, wicked. mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Earth, mould or soil. 2 Place, site. 3 Sediment, deposit of oil, &c. 4 A granary, a threshing floor. 5 A mill. m. (-लः) 1 The sun. 2 A tree with black blossoms: see तमाल. 3 The Datura plant. E. खल to gather, (misfortune, &c.) affix अच्.
खलता: खलता f. (-ता) 1 Wickedness, villainy. 2 Filthiness. E. खल, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix खलत्वं.
खलति: खलति mfn. (-तिः-तिः or -ती-ति) Bald, baldheaded. E. स्खल to fall, Uṇādi affix अतच, इ inserted, and स rejected.
खलपू: खलपू mf. (-पूः) A sweeper, a cleaner, Mehter or Ferash. E. खल place, and पू who cleans, from पूञ् to cleanse or purify, affix क्विप्.
खलप्रीति: खलप्रीति f. (-तिः) The friendship or favour of wicked or low persons. E. खल, and प्रीति affection.
खलमूर्ति: खलमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) Quicksilver. E. खल place, and मूर्त्ति form; taking the form of the place it lies in.
खलमूर्त्ति: खलमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) Quicksilver. E. खल place, and मूर्त्ति form; taking the form of the place it lies in.
खलसंसर्ग: खलसंसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Associating with bad company. E. खल, संसर्ग associating.
खलाधारा: खलाधारा f. (-रा) A cockroach. E. खल the sediment of oil, and आधार having.
खलि: खलि m. (-लिः) Sediment of oil or oil-cake. E. खल to gather, इन् aff.
खलिन्: खलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having sediment, &c. f. (नी) 1 A multitude of threshing floors. 2 A plant, (Anthericum tuberosum.) E. खल, and इनि aff.
खलिन: खलिन mn. (-नः-नं) The bit of a bridle: see खलीन.
खलिश: खलिश mf. (-शः-शा) A kind of fish, (Trichopodus colisa, HAM.) also खलेश.
खलीकार: खलीकार m. (-रः) 1 Mischief, evil. 2 Leaving or reducing to sediment. E. खल mischievous, and कार who makes; च्चि inserted.
खलीन: खलीन mn. (-नः-नं) The bit of a bridle. E. ख the mouth, and लीन what is fixed; also the vowel being made short खलिन.
खलु: खलु ind. 1 A particle of prohibition. 2 An expletive. 3 An expression of endearment or conciliation. 4 An expression indicating inquiry. 5 An expression of asseveration or ascertainment, (certainly, indeed.) 6 Only, merely. E. खल to gather, affix उ.
खलुज्: खलुज् m. (-लुक्) Darkness. E. ख the sky, लुक् dropped, lost, from लुज to efface, affix क्विप्.
खलुरेष: खलुरेष m. (-षः) A kind of wild animal; also खलुरेषक.
खलूरिका: खलूरिका f. (-का) A parade, a place for military exercise. E. खडि to break, ऊरच् affix, ड changed to ल, and कन् added.
खलेधानी: खलेधानी f. (-नी) The post of a threshing floor, round which the oxen pass who tread out the grain; also खलेवाली.
खलेबाली: खलेबाली f. (-ली) A post: see the preceding. E. खल a threshing floor in the seventh case, and बाली what is firm, a post, &c. from बल to be strong, अण् and ङीष affs.
खलेश: खलेश m. (-शः) A kind of fish, (commonly Trichopodus colisa, HAM.) see खलिश. E. खले in dirt, and श from शी to sleep; burrowing in the mud of the banks, &c.
खलेशय: खलेशय m. (-यः) The Khaliśa fish: see the preceding. E. as before, शी, and अच् aff.
खलोक्ति: खलोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Abuse, low or wicked language. E. खल, and उक्ति speech.
खल्या: खल्या mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Fit for oil cake, for a threshing floor, &c. f. (-ल्या) A multitude of threshing floors. E. खल a threshing floor, affix क्यप् यत् or य.
खल्ल: खल्ल m. (-ल्लः) 1 A kind of cloth or clothes, leather garments. 2 A canal, a cut, a creek, a trench, a deep hole. 3 The Cātaka, a kind of cuckoo. 4 Leather. 5 A leather water bag. 6 A mill, a stone or vessel for grinding drugs, &c. f. (-ल्ली) Shooting pain in the extremities. E. खल collecting, &c. and ल what gets; also खल्लक m. (-कः)
खल्लिका: खल्लिका f. (-का) A frying pan. E. कन् added to the preceding, fem. form.
खल्लिट: खल्लिट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Bald, morbidly troubled with falling of the hair; also खल्लीट.
खल्लीट: खल्लीट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Becoming morbidly bald: see the preceding.
खव: खव r. 9th cl. (खौनाति) 1 To be past birth. 2 To cause or procure prosperity. 3 To produce purity, to purify. 4 To produce or manifest wealth.
खवल्ली: खवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A parasitic plant. E. ख, and वल्ली a pedicle.
खवारि: खवारि n. (-रि) Rain water, dew, vapour, &c. E. ख heaven, and वारि water.
खवाष्प: खवाष्प m. (-ष्पः) Snow, hoar frost, dew. E. ख sky, and वाष्प vapour or tears.
खश: खश m. (-शः) 1 A mountainous country to the north of India. 2 A native of that country, considered as a degraded Kṣatriya. f. (-शा) A kind of perfume, commonly Mura.
खशय: खशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Resting or dwelling in the air. E. ख, and शी to sleep, अच् aff.
खशरीर: खशरीर n. (-रं) A celestial or immortal body. E. ख, and शरीर body.
खशरीरिन्: खशरीरिन् m. (-री-रिणी-रि) Of a heavenly body. E. खशरीर, and इनि aff.
खशेट: खशेट m. (-टः) The Khaliśa, a kind of fish: see खलेश.
खश्वास: खश्वास m. (-सः) Air or wind. E. ख the atmosphere, and श्वास breath.
खष: खष r. 1st cl. (खषति) To kill, to hurt or injure.
खष्प: खष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Anger, passion. 2 Violence, oppression. E. खन to hurt, to dig, प Uṇādi affix, न changed to ष.
खस: खस m. (-सः) 1 Itch, scab. 2 A man of a country or tribe considered to be a degraded Kṣatriya: the Khasas inhabit the mountains surrounding Kashmir. f. (-सा) The mother of the imps or goblins.
खसगन्ध: खसगन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, commonly Kṣīrakañcuki.
खसम: खसम m. (-मः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint. E. ख heaven, and सम equal, the same.
खसम्भव: खसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in the sky, aerial, ethereal. E. ख. and सम्भव birth.
खसर्पण: खसर्पण m. (-णः) One of the Buddhas or Buddha saints. n. (-णं) Gliding through the air. E. ख heaven, and सर्पण who goes to or in.
खसात्मज: खसात्मज m. (-जः) An imp or goblin. E. खसा the mother of these beings, आत्मज a son.
खस्तनी: खस्तनी f. (-नी) The earth. E. ख ether, स्तन a breast, affix ङीष्.
खस्खसरस: खस्खसरस m. (-सः) Poppy juice, opium. E. खस्खस, and रस juice.
खस्फटिक: खस्फटिक m. (-कः) 1 Crystal, the sun gem. 2 The moon gem: see सूर्य्यकान्त, and चन्द्रकान्त. E. ख heaven, and स्फटिक crystal.
खहर: खहर m. (-रः) (In arithmetic.) A fraction having a cypher for its denominator. E. ख a cypher, हर divisor.
खाजिक: खाजिक m. (-कः) Fried or parched grain. E. खज to go, &c. affix ण्वुल्.
खाट: खाट mf. (-टः-टा) 1 A bier, a cot or bedstead on which dead bodies are conveyed to the pile. E. खट to screen, affix घञ्.
खाटि: खाटि f. (-टिः) 1 Caprice, whim. 2 A scar. 3 A bier. E. खट to screen, &c. इञ् aff.
खाटिका: खाटिका f. (-का) A bier: see खाट; also खाटी.
खाण्डव: खाण्डव n. (-वं) A wood, sacred to INDRA.
खाण्डिक: खाण्डिक m. (-कः) A confectioner, a seller of sweetmeats. E. खण्ड molasses or coarse sugar, and ठक् aff.
खात: खात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dug, excavated. 2 Torn, rent. n. (-तं) 1 A square or oblong pond. 2 Any excavation. E. खन to dig, affix क्त, and the pen. lengthened.
खातक: खातक m. (-कः) 1 A delver, a digger. 2 A debtor; more correctly खादक n. (-कं) A moat, a ditch. E. खात a pond, affix कन्.
खातभू: खातभू f. (-भूः) A moat, a ditch. E. खात a pond, भू earth.
खात्र: खात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A square or large pond. 2 A spade, a hoe. 3 A wood. 4 A thread. E. खन to dig, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
खाद: खाद (ऋ) खादृ r. 1st cl. (खादति) To eat.
खादक: खादक m. (-कः) 1 A borrower, a user, (in law,) literally, an eater. 2 A feeder, one who eats or feeds. E. खाद to eat, affix वुन्.
खादन: खादन m. (-नः) A tooth. n. (-नं) 1 Eating. 2 Food, victuals. E. खाद to eat, affix ल्युट्.
खादनीय: खादनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Edible, to be eaten. E. खाद and अनीयर् aff.
खादित: खादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. खाद to eat, affix क्त.
खादितवत्: खादितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Eating, feeding. E. खाद and क्तवतु aff.
खादितव्य: खादितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be eaten, what may be or must be eaten, &c. E. खाद, and तव्य.
खादिर: खादिर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Derived from the Khayar tree. 2 Made of its wood. E. खदिर, and अण् aff.
खादिरसार: खादिरसार m. (-रः) Catechu, the resinous extract of the Mimosa catechu. E. खादिर, and सार essence.
खादुक: खादुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mischievous, injurious, malignant. E. खाद to eat, उकन् aff.
खाद्य: खाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Edible, to be eaten, what is to be or may be eaten. n. (-द्यं) Food, victuals. E. खाद to eat, यत् aff.
खानि: खानि mf. (-निः-नी) A mine. E. खन to dig, इञ् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
खानिक: खानिक n. (-कं) An opening or hole in a wall, a breach. E. खन to dig, affix ठञ्.
खानिल: खानिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A housebreaker. E. खन to dig, इलच् affix, deriv. irr.; this is sometimes read खानिन.
खानोदक: खानोदक m. (-कः) A cocoanut. E. खान rending, and उदक water.
खापगा: खापगा f. (-गा) A name of GAṄGĀ or the Ganges. E. ख heaven, and अपगा a river.
खार: खार mf. (-रः-रिः or -री) A Khāri, a measure of grain containing sixteen Droṇas, or about three bushels: it is also reckoned at three or four Droṇas; also at five Gonis, which is considered equal to 512 Ser's. f. (-री) A scar. E. खन to dig, deriv. irr.
खारिम्पच: खारिम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Cooking a Khāri, by measure (a vessel, &c.) E. खारी as above, पच to cook, affix खश्.
खारीक: खारीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A field, &c. equal to or sown with a Khāri of grain. E. खारी the measure, and इकन् or ठञ् aff.
खारीवाप: खारीवाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) A field sown with a Khāri of grain, &c. E. खारी, and वाप sowing.
खालित्य: खालित्य n. (-त्य) Morbid baldness. E. खलति, and यञ् aff.
खाशि: खाशि m. (-शिः) Name of a country to the east of Bengal: the Cossya hills; also खाशिक m. (-कः).
खाश्मरी: खाश्मरी f. (-री) A plant: see कश्मरी.
खिखि: खिखि f. (-खिः) A fox; also in some copies, किखि q. v.
खिङ्खिर: खिङ्खिर mf. (-रः-रा) A fox. m. (-रः) 1 One of ŚIVA'S weapons. 2 A kind of perfume, commonly Hāla.
खिट: खिट r. 1st cl. (खेटति) 1 To terrify, to alarm or surprise. 2 To be terrified, to fear or dread.
खिद: खिद r. 4th and 7th cls. (खिद्यते and खिंते) To be distrest, to suffer pain or misery. (औ, प) औखिदप् r. 6th cl. (खिन्दति) To afflict or distress.
खिदिर: खिदिर m. (-रः) The moon. 2 An ascetic, a penitent. 3 A pauper. E. खिद to suffer pain, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
खिद्यमान: खिद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Suffering pain or distress. E. खिद, with शानच् aff.
खिद्र: खिद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 Disease, sickness. 2 A pauper, a poor man. E. खिद, to be in pain, रक् Uṇādi aff.
खिन्न: खिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Distrest, suffering pain or uneasiness. 2 Wearied, exhausted. E. खिद to be in pain, affix क्त.
खिल: खिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Waste or unploughed land. 2 Empty. vacant. m. (-लः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 VIṢṆU. mn. (-लः-लं) A compendium, a compilation, especially of hymns and prayers. E. ख vacuity, &c. ल what gets or possesses, affix ड, and इ substituted for the penultimate.
खु: खु (ङ) खुङ् r. 1st cl. (खुवते) To sound.
खुज: खुज r. 1st cl. (उ) खुजु (खुजति) To steal or rob.
खुञ्जाक: खुञ्जाक m. (-कः) A kind of grass: see देवताडक.
खुड: खुड r. 6th cl. (खुडति) To cover. r. 1st and 10th cl. (खोडति खोडयति) also (इ,) खुडि r. 1st and 10th cl. (खुण्डति, खुण्डयति) To break in pieces, to sunder, to divide, tear, rend, &c. (इङ्) खुडिङ् r. 1st cl. (खुण्डते) To limp, to be lame.
खुर: खुर r. 6th cl. (खुरति) To cut, to scratch.

खुर m. (-रः) 1 A hoof, a horse's hoof, &c. 2 A razor. 3 The foot of a bedstead; also क्षुर. 4 A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi, apparently a dried shell fish, and of the shape of a hoof. E. खुर to cut, रन् Uṇādi affix, the radical र is dropped.
खुरक: खुरक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Tilā. E. कन् added to the preceding.
खुरक्षेप: खुरक्षेप m. (-पः) A kick, kicking. E. खुर, and क्षेप throwing.
खुरणस्: खुरणस् mfn. (-णाः-णाः-णः) Flat-nosed, having a nose like a horse's hoof. E. खुर a hoof, and नस् deriv. of नासिका a nose; also with a final vowel खुरणस. mfn. (-सः-सा-सं.)
खुरपदवी: खुरपदवी f. (-वी) A horse's foot marks. E. खुर, and पदवी vestige.
खुरप्र: खुरप्र m. (-प्रः) An arrow with a semicircular head: see क्षुरप्र.
खुरली: खुरली f. (-ली) Military exercise, practising archery, &c. E. खुर to cut, अलच् aff.
खुराक: खुराक m. (-कः) An animal in general. E. खुर to cut, and आक aff.
खुराघात: खुराघात m. (-तः) A kick. E. खुर, and आघात a blow.
खुराभिघात: खुराभिघात m. (-तः) 1 A kick. 2 Kicking, pawing, (as a horse.) E. खुर, and अभिघात, striking.
खुरालक: खुरालक m. (-कः) An iron arrow. E. खुर a razor, and अल what is able, affix कन्.
खुरालिक: खुरालिक m. (-कः) 1 A barber's case. 2 An iron arrow. 3 A pillow. E. खुर a razor, &c. अल to be equal to, affix ठक्; some read this खरालक, but to all appearance erroneously.
खुर्द: खुर्द r. 1st cl. (खुर्दते or खूर्दते) To play, to sport.
खुल्ल: खुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Small, little, low, mean, &c. n. (-ल्लं) A kind of perfume: see खुर. E. खुद to divide, &c. and ल from ला to get, the radical द becomes ल.
खुल्लक: खुल्लक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Low, vile. 2 Little, small. 2 Poor, indigent. 4 Cruel, harsh. 4 Wicked, mischievous, malignant: see क्षुल्ल.
खुल्लतात: खुल्लतात m. (-तः) A father's younger brother; also क्षुल्लतात.
खूर्द: खूर्द r. 1st cl. (खूर्दते) To play: see खुर्द.
खेखीरक: खेखीरक m. (-कः) A hollow or sounding reed, or cane.
खेगमन: खेगमन m. (-नः) A gallinule. E. खे in the air, and गमन going.
खेचर: खेचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Aerial, moving in the air. m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A Vidyādhara or kind of demigod. 3 Quicksilver. E. खे in heaven, and चर who goes.
खेट: खेट r. 1st cl. (खेटति) To alarm. r. 10th cl. (खेटयति) To eat.

खेट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Vile, bad, low. 2 Armed, having a weapon or weapons. mn. (-टः-टं) Hunting, the chase; also आखेट. m. (-टः) 1 A shield. 2 A village, the residence of peasants or farmers. 3 A small town, half the Pura or town. 4 The club of BALARĀMA. 5 Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humour. 6 The ascending node or RĀHU. 7 A horse. n. (-टं) Grass. E. खिट to terrify, &c. affix घञ्.
खेटक: खेटक m. (-कः) 1 A village, the residence of agricultural peasants. 2 A shield. 3 The club of BALARĀMA. E. खिट to terrify, &c. अच् affix, and कन् added.
खेटिताल: खेटिताल m. (-लः) A minstrel, a family bard or piper, whose business it is to awaken the Laird, with music and singing. E. खेटि derived from खिट to disturb, and ताल tune.
खेटिन्: खेटिन् m. (-टी) A lecher, a libertine. E. खेट sport, affix इनि.
खेडिताल: खेडिताल m. (-लः) A minstrel: see खेटिताल.
खेद: खेद m. (-दः) 1 Sorrow, affliction, distress. 2 Lassitude, depression. 3 Pain. 4 Poverty. E. खिद to be distrest, affix घञ्.
खेदान्वित: खेदान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distressed, pained. E. खेद, and अन्वित having.
खेदित: खेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Annoyed, harassed. 2 Afflicted, distressed, pained. E. खिद to give pain, क्त aff.
खेदिनी: खेदिनी f. (-नी) 1 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia:) see असनपर्णी. 2 A creeper, a creeping plant. E. खिद to be distrest, affixes णिनि and ङीष्.
खेय: खेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be dug. n. (-यं) A ditch, a moat. E. खत to dig, affix क्यप्.
खेल: खेल (ऋ) खेऌ r. 1st cl. (खेलति) To shake, to tremble, to move.
खेलन: खेलन n. (-नं) Play, sport, pastime. f. (-नी) A piece or man at drafts, chess, &c. E. खेल to shake or move, affix ल्युट्.
खेला: खेला f. (-ला) Play, pastime, sport. E. खेल to shake, अङ् and टाप् affs.
खेलि: खेलि f. (-लिः) 1 A song, a hymn. 2 An arrow. 3 The sun. 4 A bird. 5 Any animal. E. खेल to shake, कि aff.
खेव: खेव (ऋ) खेवृ r. 1st cl. (खेवते) To serve.
खेसर: खेसर m. (-रः) A mule. E. खे in air, सर who goes.
खै: खै r. 1st cl. (स्वायति) 1 To be firm or steady. 2 To kill, to injure or hurt. 3 To dig. 4 To mourn, to sorrow for.
खोङ्काह: खोङ्काह m. (-हः) A white and brown horse.
खोट: खोट r. 1st cl. (ऋ) खोदृ (खोटति) To be lame or lamed. r. 10th cl. (खोटयति) 1 To eat. 2 To throw or cast.
खोटि: खोटि f. (-टिः) A cunning or scheming woman; also read खोरि.
खोटी: खोटी f. (-टी) The gum olibanum tree.
खोड: खोड (ऋ) खोडृ r. 1st cl. (खोडति) To be or become lame. r. 10th cl. (खोडयति) To throw or cast.
खोड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Lame, limping. E. खोड to be lame, affix अच्.
खोडकशीर्ष: खोडकशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) The arched roof of a house, the coping of a wall, &c. also खोडकशीर्षकः.
खोर: खोर (ऋ) खोरृ r. 1st cl. (खोरति) To be lame, to be prevented from moving.
खोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Lame. E. खोर to be lame, affix अच्; also खोड, and खोल.
खोल: खोल (ऋ) खोऌ r. 1st cl. (खोलति) To be lame, to limp, to be prevented from moving. खोड, खोर, &c. are conceived by some authorities to be mere variations in the form of this root.
खोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Lame. E. खोल to be lame, affix अच्; also खोर, &c.
खोलक: खोलक m. (-कः) 1 A helmet, armour for the head. 2 A pot, a saucepan. 3 An ant hill. 4 The shell of the betel nut. E. खुड to cover, affix ण्वुल्, ड changed to ल.
खोल्क: खोल्क m. (-ल्कः) 1 A meteor. 2 A planet. E. ख, and उल्का torch.
खोल्मुक: खोल्मुक m. (-कः) The planet MARS. E. ख heaven, उल्मुक a hot coal.
ख्या: ख्या r. 2nd cl. (ख्याति) 1 To relate, to recount, to say or tell. 2 To celebrate, to make known. With अभि prefixed, To shine or be glorious. With आ, To be famous. With वि, To celebrate. With सु, To be approved. With कु, To be infamous. With प्रति and आ, To reject, to refuse. With सम्, To count, to reckon. With सं and आ, To denominate.
ख्यात: ख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Famous, celebrated, notorious. E. ख्या to relate, affix क्त.
ख्यातगर्हण: ख्यातगर्हण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Notoriously vile, infamous. E. ख्यात famous, गर्हण abuse; also ख्यातगर्हित.
ख्यातगर्हित: ख्यातगर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Infamous: see the preceding.
ख्याति: ख्याति f. (तिः) Fame, celebrity. E. ख्या to tell, affix क्तिन्.
ख्यापक: ख्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Declaring, making known, one who tells or declares. 2 One who confesses. E. ख्या to say, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.
ख्यापन: ख्यापन n. (-नं) 1 Declaring, divulging, 2 Saying, avowing. 3 Confessing. 4 Explaining. E. ख्या causal form, ल्युट् aff. ग
